# What's New in the New BombBomb

Patryk Romanczuk·October 27, 2026 at 11:44 AM

## Overview

The new BombBomb comes with a simpler left sidebar. Everything you used before is still here, but several areas have new names or new homes, and a few areas are brand new. Use this page as a map: find the place you remember, see where it lives now, and follow the link to that area's full article.

**Who this applies to:** All users of the new BombBomb. The **Admin** section applies to Admins, Team Admins, and Content Admins on a team.

**Plan requirement:** All plans. Email and Contacts are included on the Pro and Enterprise plans only, not on Essentials.

* * *

## Known Limitations

- **Integrations** in the sidebar may not be available on every account yet. It's no longer in your account menu, so if you don't see it in the sidebar, contact BombBomb Support.
- The **Admin** section only appears for Admins, Team Admins, and Content Admins on a team.
- **Email** and **Contacts** are included on the Pro and Enterprise plans only.
- Contacts can't connect new contact sources yet.

* * *

## Where Everything Moved

| If you used to go to… | In the new BombBomb, go to… |
| --- | --- |
| **Workspace** | **Library** |
| **Create Video** at the top of the sidebar | **Record Video** at the top of the sidebar |
| Workspace as your starting page | **Dashboard** |
| **My Insights** | **Insights** → **My Insights** tab |
| **Account Insights** or **Team Insights** | **Insights** → **Account Insights** tab |
| **Manage Account** → users | **Admin** → **All Users** |
| **Manage Account** → teams, or **Manage Team** | **Admin** → **Teams** |
| **Manage Account** (player page defaults, permissions, AI Content Library) | **Admin** → **Account Settings** |
| **Manage Account** → **Plan & Billing** | **Admin** → **Account Settings** → **Plan & Billing** (if you manage your account's billing) |
| **Classic Features** → Emails | **Email** in the sidebar |
| **Classic Features** → Contacts / Lists | **Contacts** in the sidebar |
| **Classic Features** → Automations | **Return to Classic** in the banner, then **Automations** in Classic |
| **Classic Features** → other Classic tools | **Return to Classic** in the banner at the top of the page |
| Integrations in your account menu | **Integrations** near the bottom of the sidebar |
| The BombBomb desktop screen recorder app, in Chrome or Edge | **Record Screen**, which now records right in your browser with nothing to install |
| Nothing (new) | **Notifications** near the bottom of the sidebar |

* * *

## Understanding the New Sidebar

The sidebar is now one flat list, so every main area is a single click away, with **Record Video** at the top and **Notifications**, **Integrations**, **Chat with Us**, and your account menu at the bottom. For a full tour, see [How to Navigate the New BombBomb as a Team Member](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/43765280816781) or, if you manage users, teams, or account settings, [How to Navigate the New BombBomb as an Admin or Content Admin](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/35884815479437).

![The new sidebar as an Admin sees it, from Record Video down to Chat with Us and the account menu](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938569371149)

* * *

## What's New in Each Area

### Dashboard

**Dashboard** is your new home page: it's the page you land on when you sign in and when you click the BombBomb logo. See [How to Use Your Dashboard](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49938593508365).

![](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600936717)

### Library (formerly Workspace)

**Workspace** is now called **Library**. Your videos haven't moved: **All My Videos**, **Favorites**, **My Labels**, and **Shared Videos** for your teams are all in the same place, and **Virtual Backgrounds** is a tab at the top of the page. See [How to Organize Videos in Library](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/35965509812237).

![The Library page with the Videos and Virtual Backgrounds tabs, My Videos, and Shared Videos](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600937613)

### Record Video

The button at the top of the sidebar that starts a new recording is now called **Record Video**. In **Library**, the **New Video** button is still there, with **Record Video**, **Upload Video**, and **Record Screen** in its menu. See [How to Record a Video](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/35976507642893).

### Screen Recorder

In Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge, **Record Screen** now records your screen right in your browser, with nothing to install. You can record a browser tab, a window, or your entire screen, and include your camera when you record your entire screen. In other browsers and in BombBomb Classic, **Record Screen** still uses the BombBomb desktop screen recorder app. See [How to Use the Screen Recorder](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/38449085259789).

### Email

**Email** in the sidebar opens the new **Email** page, where you send, track, and organize your emails and manage templates. Email is included on the Pro and Enterprise plans only. See [Understanding Emails in the New BombBomb](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49938609517325).

![](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600937997)

### Contacts

**Contacts** in the sidebar opens the new Contacts page, where you manage contacts, suppressed recipients, and lists. Contacts is included on the Pro and Enterprise plans only, and it can't connect new contact sources yet. See [Understanding Contacts in the New BombBomb](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49938601559565).

![](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600939149)

### Insights

**My Insights** and **Account Insights** used to be separate sidebar links. Now there's a single **Insights** item, with **My Insights** and **Account Insights** as tabs at the top of the page.

- **My Insights** — analytics for your own videos.
- **Account Insights** — analytics across your company. Use the company selector in the top-right corner to switch between your entire company and a single team; this replaces the old **Team Insights** link. The tab keeps the name **Account Insights** either way.

![The Insights page with the My Insights and Account Insights tabs and the company selector](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600940301)

See [How to Use Insights and Team Reports](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36075879456525).

### Admin

What used to be **Manage Account** is now an **Admin** section in the sidebar, below **Insights**:

- **All Users** — invite, review, and manage the users on your account. Admins only.
- **Teams** — Admins see and manage all teams. Team Admins go straight to managing their own team; this replaces the old **Manage Team** link. Content Admins on a team also see **Teams**, which opens that team's **Player Page Defaults**.
- **Account Settings** — **Player Page Defaults**, **Permissions**, and **AI Content Library**, plus **Plan & Billing** if you manage your account's billing. Admins only.

Users and teams are no longer tabs inside Account Settings; each has its own link in the Admin section. See [How to Add Users and Track Invitations](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36010994023565) and [How to Manage Teams and Permissions](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36010846767117).

### Notifications

Click **Notifications** near the bottom of the sidebar to see recent engagement on your videos and emails, such as likes, comments, video plays, and sends. In the panel you can:

- **Filter** the list by **Opens**, **Plays**, **Clicks**, **Sends**, **Likes**, or **Comments**.
- Click **Mark all as read** to clear the unread count. Your notifications stay in the list.
- Click the gear icon ( **Notification settings**) to open the **Notifications** tab of your profile settings.

![The Notifications panel with Mark all as read, Filter, and recent likes, comments, and plays](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600941837)

See [How to Set Up and Use Notifications](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36096981091981).

* * *

## Switching Between the New BombBomb and Classic

If you have access to BombBomb Classic, a banner at the top of the page lets you move between the two:

- **Return to Classic** ( **Explore Classic** on Engage-only subscriptions) — opens your default page in BombBomb Classic. To come back, click **Explore Engage** in Classic.
- **Learn More** — opens the What's New section of our help center, where you'll find this article.

![The banner with Learn More highlighted next to Return to Classic](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/article_attachments/49938600945293)

The **Classic Features** menu is no longer in the sidebar. Emails and Contacts have their own sidebar items, and if your account has Forms, **Forms** appears in the sidebar and opens in Classic. For any other Classic tool, click **Return to Classic** and find it there.

> **Looking for Automations?** There's no **Automations** item in the new sidebar. Click **Return to Classic**, then click **Automations** in Classic's navigation. You only see it if your account has access to Classic Automations. Classic Automations isn't the same feature as **Automated Workflows** in the new sidebar.

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Are my videos still there?** Yes. **Workspace** was renamed **Library**; your videos, favorites, labels, and shared team videos are all there.

**Why don't I see Email or Contacts?** Email and Contacts are included on the Pro and Enterprise plans only. They aren't part of the Essentials plan.

**Where did Manage Account go?** It's now the **Admin** section of the sidebar: **All Users** for users, **Teams** for teams, and **Account Settings** for player page defaults, permissions, the AI Content Library, and (if you manage your account's billing) **Plan & Billing**.

**Why don't I see the Admin section?** It only appears for Admins, who see **All Users**, **Teams**, and **Account Settings**; for Team Admins, who see **Teams**; and for Content Admins on a team, who see **Teams** with their team's **Player Page Defaults**. Members and account-level Content Admins don't see it.

**Where are Team Insights now?** Click **Insights**, select the **Account Insights** tab, then choose your team from the company selector in the top-right corner.

**Why does Account Insights tell me to contact my Admin?** Account or team Insights aren't turned on for you. Your **My Insights** tab still works; ask your Admin if you need company or team analytics.

**Where are my Automations?** Classic Automations stays in Classic. Click **Return to Classic** in the banner, then click **Automations**. It isn't the same as **Automated Workflows** in the new sidebar.

**Where are my personal settings?** Click your name in the bottom-left corner of the sidebar, then choose **Profile**, **Email & Password**, or **Player Page**.

**Can I still use BombBomb Classic?** If you have access to Classic, click **Return to Classic** (or **Explore Classic**) in the banner at the top of the page. To come back, click **Explore Engage** in Classic.
